# Smithsonian Magazine

> Smithsonian Magazine is a premier publication offering curated content on history, science, culture, and nature, with subscription options, membership benefits, and community engagement through photo contests.

The site provides access to Smithsonian Magazine's editorial content and membership programs, including subscription services, gift options, and interactive contests that engage readers in photography and storytelling. Smithsonian Magazine serves as the public-facing platform for the Smithsonian Institution's cultural and educational mission.

## Subscriptions & Membership

- [Subscribe to Smithsonian Magazine](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com): Main subscription page for Smithsonian Magazine and membership offerings with pricing and membership benefits.
- [Subscribe to Smithsonian Magazine | Give a Gift](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com/gift): Gift subscription page for Smithsonian Magazine with pricing, membership benefits, and gift card options.

## Photo Contest & Community

- [Welcome to the 2025 Smithsonian Magazine Photo Contest](https://photocontest.smithsonianmag.com/photocontest): 2025 Smithsonian Magazine Photo Contest homepage featuring finalists, voting, and Reader's Choice awards for wildlife and travel photography.
- [Hands Down | Smithsonian Photo Contest](https://photocontest.smithsonianmag.com/photocontest/detail/hands-down): Wildlife photography entry featuring coastal bears in Alaska from the Smithsonian Magazine Photo Contest.
